objective: top1 scheduled-day mean net open_to_close return after cost
selection_rule: choose the fixed candidate with maximum 2025-01..03 top1.net_mean_pct_at_cost; benchmark winner only
hyperparameter_policy: one predeclared specification per family; exploration is diagnostic and does not tune a grid

leakage_guards.unfilled: rank first, then zero return and zero cost
leakage_guards.benchmark_access: only the selection-period winner is evaluated
leakage_guards.session_calendar: explicit observed-session list from canonical input; detects row-level incomplete sessions but cannot prove that an entirely absent exchange session was not omitted upstream

current_logit.score: P(close > open); used only as a same-day rank score

pairwise_linear_rank.pair_target: higher realised open_to_close return within training date
pairwise_linear_rank.imputer: median_with_missing_indicators fitted on original training rows
pairwise_linear_rank.scaler: standard fitted on original training rows
pairwise_linear_rank.pair_sampling: seeded with replacement; equal-return pairs discarded
pairwise_linear_rank.orientation: each high-minus-low pair plus its negative
pairwise_linear_rank.date_weight: all oriented pair weights sum to one per training date
pairwise_linear_rank.score: linear decision value w dot transformed_features

return_weighted_logit.date_weight: clip(abs(open_to_close_return_pct), floor, cap), then normalise weights to sum to one within each training date
return_weighted_logit.score: weighted P(close > open); same-day rank only
